integrity: The proof is an exact, bidirectional classification of all independent dominating sets through their selected original vertices, with the subdivision selection forced edge by edge. The bivariate and minimum-count formulas are consequences; direct independent adjacency-based verification agrees for all tested connected triangle-free atlas graphs.
scientific_limitations: Applies to central graphs of connected triangle-free simple graphs with at least three vertices and at least two edges.
The bivariate statistic distinguishes the original and newly subdividing vertices; this is intrinsic for original order at least four and construction-marked at order three.
The minimum cardinality is prior art from arXiv:2609.16357v1, whereas complete all-set classification and counting are the present subject.
Finite atlas verification covers all connected triangle-free unlabeled graphs through original order seven, not arbitrary graphs.
Absolute originality cannot be proved by database search; terminology and literature indexing remain residual risks.
title: Bivariate enumeration of independent dominating sets in central graphs of triangle-free graphs
